_comment: Worked examples: a real question, and the calls that answer it.
WHY. Oracle names few-shot examples as one of the strongest levers on NL2SQL
accuracy, and builds them from a feedback loop into a vector index. This is the
same idea at the scale this server needs: a small maintained file, matched by
keyword, surfaced when the question looks similar.
Each example is a SHAPE, not an answer. It shows which tool to reach for and
which trap applies — the values will differ every time.
Add one whenever a question takes several attempts to get right. The attempt
that finally worked is exactly what the next caller needs.

examples.question: מה המחזור שלנו ב-2024?
calls: aggregate{entity:'AINVOICES', groupBy:[], aggregate:[{fn:'sum',column:'QPRICE'},{fn:'count'}], filter:"IVDATE ge 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z and IVDATE lt 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
examples.notes: Use aggregate, never query — a total built from query's 500-row page is wrong. Repeat per invoice screen (AINVOICES, EINVOICES, FINVOICES) and report each separately; CINVOICES may restate amounts already counted. Group by currency if the screen carries more than one.

examples.question: מכירות לפי חודש
examples.notes: Dates group by DAY. Combine the days into months yourself, or filter to one month at a time. There is no month() function available in the filter.

examples.question: מי הלקוחות הגדולים ביותר?
examples.notes: Groups come back largest first, so the top N is just the first N. CUSTNAME is the code; join to CUSTOMERS for the name, or read CDES if the invoice screen carries it.

examples.question: אילו ערכים יש בעמודה הזו?
examples.notes: Do this BEFORE filtering on any code column. A filter on a value that does not exist returns zero rows, which reads as 'no data' rather than 'wrong code'.

examples.question: תראה לי את שורות החשבונית
examples.notes: Lines are a sub-form, not a screen — query{entity:'AINVOICEITEMS'} returns 404. Use expand for many headers, a keyed path for one. Never combine a parent select with expand: it truncates the response.

examples.question: כמה שורות יש במסך הזה?
examples.notes: There is no row total from the server — $count is accepted and ignored. aggregate pages to the end and counts, which is the only exact answer available.

examples.question: מה זה המסך הזה ומה יש בו?
examples.notes: Help text comes back by default and is usually the fastest way in — read it before inferring purpose from column names. depth:1 adds the sub-forms and normally costs no extra request.

examples.question: חשבוניות שבוטלו
examples.notes: Priority cancels by writing a mirror-image reversing document, so a cancellation is a PAIR that nets to zero — and the two halves can fall in different periods. A month can look negative because a reversal landed in it while its original did not. Credit notes are SALECREDITINVOICES, a sub-form of SALES; CINVOICES is consolidated invoices, not credits.
